project.name: Æion Core
project.description: A local web application that takes a feature from brainstorm to an AxiomSpec specification and the feature file aeion-observability builds, with cited documentation.

sources.locator: owner request, 2026-11-09/10: aeion-core webapp (brainstorm, spec studio, docs) on Flue agents

nodes.title: Brainstorm a feature until it survives review

data.description: The Elephant questions the owner's idea until a hypothesis is anchored; seven fresh Goldfish review it and a brief is saved.
data.success_measure: A brainstorm ends with a saved brief whose analysis names every reviewer, completed or not run.

nodes.title: Specify a feature the build factory can implement

data.description: A feature document becomes AxiomSpec obligations that pass the template's gates, then an export aeion-observability accepts.
data.success_measure: Every exported feature file loads in the build factory's catalog with its contract current.

nodes.title: Answer documentation questions with checkable citations

data.description: Every document is findable, and the assistant answers only from evidence its tools returned.
data.success_measure: Every citation in an answer links to a page section or graph node returned in that run.

nodes.title: Run model work as checked agents

data.description: Each model task is a dedicated Flue agent whose results are validated by code; the key stays in the server.
data.success_measure: No stored value comes from an agent without passing its schema and checks.

data.description: The server answers only this machine, refuses cross-site writes and never returns secrets or unsafe markup.
data.success_measure: Every security test of the engine passes.

data.subject: agent launcher
data.response: send the turn's message only through --message and the supporting material only through the input file

data.subject: agent launcher
data.response: request reasoning effort max with thinking enabled on every model call

nodes.title: Keep the key in the server

data.trigger: a request carries an unknown run token or names another model
data.subject: gateway
data.response: refuse the request without contacting the upstream

data.trigger: a submission does not match its schema
data.subject: agent gateway
data.response: refuse it with the failing fields and record nothing

nodes.title: Return failing checks to the agent

data.trigger: a schema-valid submission fails a deterministic check
data.subject: agent gateway
data.response: record the value and return the failing checks until the attempts run out

nodes.title: Anchor the hypothesis through a tool

data.trigger: the Elephant anchors a hypothesis
data.subject: brainstorm
data.response: store the hypothesis the Elephant passed to its tool and open the readiness gate

data.trigger: the owner opens the Goldfish review
data.subject: brainstorm
data.response: run seven reviewers that receive the hypothesis and never the conversation

nodes.title: Report a failed reviewer as not run

data.trigger: a reviewer fails twice
data.subject: Goldfish review
data.response: report the reviewer as not run, never as having no findings

nodes.title: Apply an edit only where it fits once

data.trigger: a proposed edit's text does not occur exactly once in the document
data.subject: design review
data.response: refuse the edit and tell the resolver

data.trigger: the analyst submits a fragment
data.subject: spec studio
data.response: store the requirement with lowercase clauses and no final period

data.trigger: an agent submission or patch sets a decision's answer
data.subject: spec studio
data.response: keep the decision unanswered

nodes.title: Refuse approval while questions are open

data.trigger: a blocking decision or assumption is still open
data.subject: spec studio
data.response: refuse the approval and keep the feature in the interview

nodes.title: Export what the build factory accepts

data.trigger: the owner approves a ready feature
data.subject: spec studio
data.response: write an eight-section file of at most 12,000 bytes with acceptance checks and its manifest row

nodes.title: Follow the build factory's scope rules

data.trigger: a write path is not literal, hidden, parental or outside the product roots
data.subject: spec studio
data.response: report a write-paths issue and block the export

data.trigger: an answer cites a number no tool returned in that run
data.subject: docs assistant
data.response: drop the citation from the sources

data.trigger: the librarian opens a page section
data.subject: docs assistant
data.response: return the section down to the next heading of the same level

nodes.title: Refuse foreign hosts and cross-site writes

data.trigger: a request names another host, or a write lacks the custom header or a JSON body
data.subject: web server
data.response: refuse the request with status 403

data.trigger: a session or feature name is not a plain lowercase name
data.subject: store
data.response: refuse the name before it becomes a path

data.subject: Markdown renderer
data.response: escape HTML and drop unsafe links, checking a link before rewriting it

data.subject: web server
data.response: report the model, reasoning level and readiness without any key or stack trace

data.trigger: a patch still fails its checks when its attempts run out, or sets a value outside the AxiomSpec schema
data.subject: spec studio
data.response: leave the specification unchanged and tell the owner which check still fails

nodes.title: Never save what the gates refuse

data.trigger: a save would add a strict JSON, schema, reference or BCIR error
data.subject: spec studio
data.response: refuse the save and leave the stored specification unchanged

nodes.title: Report gates that did not run as unknown

data.trigger: the schema check fails
data.subject: spec studio
data.response: report the other design gates as unknown and the feature as not ready

nodes.title: Approve only against the build factory's catalog

data.trigger: the aeion-observability catalog cannot be read
data.subject: spec studio
data.response: refuse the approval and name the setting to fix

data.trigger: the configured host is not a loopback address, or a request comes from another machine
data.subject: web server
data.response: refuse to start, or refuse the request with status 403

data.trigger: a request's Content-Length is not plain digits or exceeds the limit
data.subject: web server and gateway
data.response: refuse the request with status 400 or 413 before reading its body

nodes.title: One flue run sends each input once

data.oracle: A real flue run's request holds the report marker and the message exactly once, effort max, thinking enabled.

nodes.title: Relay adds the key and meters usage

data.oracle: The upstream receives the key, the session header and the user agent; the run records the usage.

nodes.title: Unknown token or model is refused

data.oracle: An unknown token gets 401 and another model 400; the upstream receives nothing.
An upstream 403 reaches the caller without the key in its body.
A value with an overlong item is refused, naming the path, and no submission is recorded.
A schema-valid value without problems is accepted and ends the turn.
Failing checks are returned without ending the turn until the last attempt, which records the value.
The idea is the first message, no block repeats the new message, and the tool's hypothesis is stored.
Seven goldfish runs each receive the hypothesis as their last block and no conversation.
Two failures give status not run with an empty report.
A resolution whose find text is absent is refused with its count; the corrected one applies.
The stored trigger, subject and response are lowercase without a final period, and the decision has no answer.
A patch that relinks a test and sets a decision answer changes the links only.

nodes.title: Approval refused while a decision is open

data.oracle: Approving with a blocking decision open raises a refusal, writes no export and leaves the records draft.
After the owner answers, the feature is ready and approval writes 101-*.md under 12,000 bytes with checks and frontmatter.
A fragment with a pattern error gets PATTERN_FIELDS on r1 back; the corrected one is accepted.
Hidden, doubled-slash, foreign and parent paths each produce a WRITE_PATHS issue.
An amendment before a submission is refused; after one, it replaces the item by key and is accepted.
An answer citing [1] and [7] after one search keeps source 1 only.
A level-2 section includes its level-3 child and stops before the next level-2 heading.
A request with another Host header gets 403.
A JSON write without X-Aeion and a form write with it both get 403.
The page carries script-src 'self' and frame denial.
Traversal, uppercase, empty, overlong and NUL names raise a refusal.
A saved feature reads back with its title and byte count.
Script tags are escaped and javascript links removed.
A javascript link is dropped even when a rewriter would make it safe.
Status reports ready and max reasoning, with no key line.
An unknown session is 404 without a traceback.
Opening a review before a hypothesis raises a refusal.
Calling a tool the run did not declare is refused.
A registered tool returns its output through the bridge; a missing one is reported unavailable.
A review input numbers only the range and carries the standard in one block.
A block equal to the message, or a non-conversation block containing a long message, is refused before any run.
A patch setting priority 7 and an object risk is refused as outside the schema until its attempts run out; spec.json keeps its bytes and the owner is told no change was applied.
A patch lowering a requirement's priority is accepted at once; spec.json holds the new value at the next revision.
Saving a spec with a schema error or a dangling edge raises a refusal naming G01 or G02 and leaves the file unchanged.

nodes.title: Gates after a schema failure unknown

data.oracle: With a schema error, G01 is error, G02 to G07 are unknown and the feature is not design-ready.
Approving a ready feature while the catalog cannot be read is refused, naming AEION_OBSERVABILITY, and writes no export.

nodes.title: Export loads in the build factory's loader

data.oracle: aeion-observability's own load_manifest accepts a copy of its catalog with the exported file and row added, and the new feature's contract is current.
AEION_HOST set to 0.0.0.0, a LAN address, ::, a name or nothing raises ConfigError; loopback values load.
A read and a valid write from peer 192.168.1.29 both get 403 and no feature is stored.
A write with Content-Length -1 or abc gets 400, one over 2 MB gets 413, and nothing is stored.
A relay request with Content-Length -1 or abc gets 400, one over 16 MB gets 413, and the upstream receives nothing.
With a sentinel key held by the real agent client, no page, API answer, refusal or header contains it.

nodes.title: Owner question instead of a section

data.oracle: An ask_owner call turns the section into a question that cannot be approved.

data.responsibility: Serves the page and the JSON API, stores sessions and features, renders Markdown safely.
data.boundary: app/aeion server, store, config and markdown; loopback only

data.responsibility: Launches one Flue agent per task, relays its model calls with the key and validates its submissions.
data.boundary: app/aeion/agents.py and app/flue; the key never leaves the server process

data.responsibility: Runs the Elephant conversation, the Goldfish reviews, drafting and resolution.
Merges checked fragments into the product spec, runs the interview and exports approved features.
data.boundary: app/aeion/specstudio.py; reads aeion-observability, never writes it

data.responsibility: Indexes every document, serves pages with diagrams and runs the librarian's tools.

data.definition: One flue run of one role agent: one message, one input file, a disposable conversation.
A typed result an agent passes to a submit tool; stored only after its schema and checks.

data.question: Which harness runs the model work?
options: Flue agents with dedicated tools and skills
data.answer: Flue agents with dedicated tools and skills (owner, 2026-11-10)
data.rationale: The owner asked for Flue, with deepseek-v4.1-flash at maximum reasoning.

data.claim: The owner's machine has Node.js 22.19 or newer for the Flue harness.
data.validation_method: app/serve reports the agents as ready.
